wilyer-abreu.name: Wilyer Abreu
wilyer-abreu.top: Abreu is a lift-and-barrel power hitter who gets his value from extra-base damage rather than batting average. His contact skills and swing rates are average, but he launches the ball well enough to rank near the top fifth of the league in expected power. In 2026 he moved from a platoon role to everyday at-bats and held his level.

steven-kwan.name: Steven Kwan
steven-kwan.top: Kwan is an extreme contact-and-control hitter: he almost never chases or misses, and he repeats a line-drive launch better than anyone, but he hits the ball with the lowest exit velocity of any qualified hitter. His value comes from batting average and, increasingly, walks, with almost no power behind it.

cody-bellinger.name: Cody Bellinger
cody-bellinger.top: Bellinger is a contact-and-launch hitter, not a slugger. He rarely misses and lifts the ball efficiently to his pull side, which produces slightly above-average output driven by batting average rather than extra-base damage.

sal-frelick.name: Sal Frelick
sal-frelick.top: Frelick is a contact-first, ground-ball hitter whose value comes almost entirely from putting the ball in play: he rarely misses, rarely strikes out and rarely chases. What he does not do is drive the ball, and with modest exit velocity spent mostly on the ground, his expected output sits well below average.
